name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.difference_moments
type_text:
∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ →
                  ∀ (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
                    (O :
                      OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                        ∀ (batch : ℕ),
                          have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                          have error := outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.batchError q f O batch;
                          MeasureTheory.Integrable error P ∧
                            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ‖error z‖ ^ 2) P ∧
                              ∀ (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                                MeasurableSet E →
                                  (∀ z ∈ E, outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.isDifferenceBatch q O z batch) →
                                    ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                                          error z ∂P =
                                        0 ∧
                                      ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                                          ‖error z‖ ^ 2 ∂P ≤
                                        Lpm ^ 2 / ↑q.S *
                                          ∫ (z :
                                            outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                                            ‖(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.batchInputs q O z.1 z.2 batch).1 -
                                                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.batchInputs q O z.1 z.2 batch).2‖ ^
                                              2 ∂P
